summary: A 1932 L-4 cab on Ruffneck Peak near the Frank Church wilderness, now listed for emergency use; sources disagree on staffing.

access.note: Listed as available for emergencies only. In or next to the Frank Church River of No Return Wilderness, and reached on foot.

visit.trail_note: Hike-in site in or near the Frank Church River of No Return Wilderness. No route or distance checked.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Older newspaper quotes and the Keeping Watch web address spell it Roughneck. The register and Idaho Fire Lookouts use Ruffneck, which the record uses.

notes_for_editor: Two live disagreements. (1) Current use: Keeping Watch (an undated video page) and Wikipedia say staffed seasonally; firelookout.com and the Idaho Fire Lookouts July 2025 post say emergency status. The fact is recorded as emergency use dated 2025, and the story says the sources differ. (2) Last staffed decade: 1980s (register, Idaho Fire Lookouts) vs 1990s (firelookout.com). Idaho Fire Lookouts lists staff for 1984 and 1985 despite its own 1980s end date. Elevation: the register gives 9,291 ft (2,832 m), matching the record's 2831.9 m; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 9,407 ft, and Wikipedia gives 9,407 ft (2,867 m) for the peak. The record may be using the register's lookout figure, so a human should decide. Not read: Forest Service pages and any 2001 return-to-service record.
